amath_priority.scope: General department policy; section-specific notes take precedence.
amath_priority.other_students_including_minors: Generally wait until Period II before attempting registration.
amath_priority.full_course_add_codes: Generally not distributed except in special circumstances.
amath_priority.stale_link_warning: The advising page links a 2025-2026 calendar and lists Autumn 2026 exceptions. Use the separately checked 2026-2027 calendar for Winter 2027 dates; do not apply Autumn exceptions to Winter.

linked_components.rule: Courses with related lab/quiz sections require simultaneous registration in the lecture and its related lab/quiz.

late_add_codes.rule: An add code is required for any course beginning on the eighth calendar day of the quarter.

in_progress_prerequisites.rule: Registration may be provisional when the student is currently registered in a prerequisite. Departments can cancel the dependent registration if the prerequisite is not satisfactorily completed.

integration_notes: Merge by term + campus + SLN. Do not replace all prior evidence with this 10-course subset.
Known restrictions can determine a failed condition even when complete eligibility remains unknown.
No indicator displayed does not mean unrestricted registration.
Do not treat prefix-based lecture/quiz group candidates as verified legal pairings.
Major label CSE and ECE must be mapped explicitly to the application major model.
Only the three tentative CSE 373 quiz sections have newly explicit add-code evidence in this reviewed subset.
Keep prerequisite, registration and schedule-compatibility decisions separate.
The v2 SLN notes and structured rules supersede the v1 unresolved-detail statements for these 90 SLNs only.
CSE 373 excludes C SCI and CMP E majors; a non-major label alone was insufficient evidence in v1.
AMATH 351, 352 and 482 explicitly allow AMATH, CFRM and ACMS during Period I. No pathway qualifier appears in these exact section notes.
Do not extend the AMATH Period I major filter past November 22. No Grads remains separately applicable to AMATH 352 and 482.
AMATH 301 has no major or student-level restriction in the captured Notes tables. Do not infer complete eligibility or impose the general department priority as a section-specific hard rule.
Joint offerings describe counterpart sections, not permission to mix lectures and quizzes across groups.
No registration actions or forms were submitted; no student record was exported.
